notes: Browser-local HTTP navigation was actually attempted and blocked by administrator policy. No browser policy changes were made. Native views use Blob URLs; virtual HTTP playback is not claimed.

The first source-pair setup failed strict sample-description identity because btrt fields differed. Sources were reauthored with -write_btrt 0. This is a qualified-fixture adjustment, not a general equivalence transform.
Initial native source reference reads sampled two pictures per source. Final browser_views.json expanded both to all 40 source ordinals; browser_views_initial.json is retained.

Edited parser was tightened to require actual AVC IDR plus declared sync at starts/ends. Added forged sync and unequal configuration unit controls. Regeneration retained the same media identities checked by the browser.

AV1 outputs initially inherited AVC-compatible ftyp brands from the header skeleton. Final artifacts use an AV1-compatible brand list; both AVIF browser stages were rerun after this authoring correction.
RGB AVIF was tested as a separate authored input subgroup following failed YUV image/video exactness. No conversion of original YUV to RGB is presented as an optimization.
D36/D37 complete Blob reads are test-only byte oracles; candidate construction uses header plus source Blob slices. Internal browser copies and setup transport copies remain unmeasured.
The original YUV sequence mutation is a unit-level record predicate. The RGB follow-up uses an actual compatibility function and valid incompatible RGB/YUV extracted records.
69 verification checks include intentional failures. Scientific outcomes are separate. No performance result is inferred from verification pass counts.
